text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:

- Berge Furre, a member of the government-appointed Lund committee which has investigated the secret service's work up to 1994, was himself under investigation by the secret service while working in the committee.

- A report shows that more than 50 percent of the mentally disabled have developed larger behaviour difficulties following a reform that closed the large institutions and moved the patients to smaller institutions closer to home.
- Several macro economist say that the opposition's suggestions to increase expenses in the 1997 National Budget will send the wrong signals to the rest of the economy.

- Jon Chr. Brynildsen, owner of shipping company Irgens Larsen, who bought eigth refrigerated carrier ships from Kvaerner ASA on Wednesday, wants to increase the company's current fleet of eight ships to 12-14 ships.
